skater_rank_basis: Current-season observed impact. Net xGAR includes actual workload; offence and defence are reliability-adjusted ratings shown separately. Players without current-season minutes are not ranked. SOAI process dimensions and top-line hold remain context, not an unvalidated composite total.
fantasy_rank_basis: The 2026-2027 fantasy board first forecasts NHL appearance, then games conditional on appearing, deployment and category rates. Historical tests retain cutoff-eligible players who record zero following-season games. Category-rate candidates may use workload-standardized isolated skill, response reliability and overlap, but only when they win nested development selection. The exact conditional 5v5 process, own conversion, teammate conversion, defensive conversion and residuals are displayed beside the fantasy scoring decomposition and cutoff-time environment deltas. Expected goals and assists receive a zero-preserving season-total calibration fit only on older rolling out-of-sample seasons. G high and P high are upper ends of a central 90% historical error range, not point forecasts. The default score is 3 per goal, 2 per assist, 0.25 per shot, 0.5 per power-play point, 0.2 per hit and 0.3 per block. Score RMSE is player-equal rolling out-of-sample error with team-season clustered uncertainty, not a confidence interval for one player.
goalie_fantasy_rank_basis: Upcoming-season goalie workload and rates are forecast separately in strict rolling-origin tests. The final two completed seasons are retired diagnostics and cannot select the model. Fantasy Score uses 4 per win, 0.2 per save, -2 per goal allowed and 3 per shutout; raw categories remain sortable for other league formats.
goalie_rank_basis: Completed-season goalie performance. The default rank uses total shot-quality-adjusted goals saved above expected so workload and performance both count; per-60, save percentage, expected save percentage and penalty-kill results remain sortable context. Empty-net shots are excluded and goalies need at least min(10, ceil(10% of an 82-game season)) starts to qualify.
team_rank_basis: Forward-looking strength uses the projected 12-forward/6-defender roster, pooled SOAI net, projected fantasy scoring and prior team form. Projected roles determine lines, pairs and PP/PK units but are not counted again as talent. Models were selected on 2024-25 and accepted only after a locked 2025-26 test. Across both outer folds, pooled SOAI improved game log loss by 0.0038 and season points RMSE by 0.56 versus prior form. The playoff model's SOAI, role and fantasy inputs improved qualification Brier score by 0.0089. Historical replays assign players only to their feature-season teams; following-season team destinations are forbidden. SOAI offence and defence remain visible matchup components, while pooled net drives expected points.
underrated_rank_basis: Talent, role, and context statistics are combined into an underplayed score. Metrics are heavily weighted toward the current season, but use the last 3 seasons to assign certainty. Fits and models are trained solely on data available through the public NHL API. All analysis on this page excludes empty-net goals unless otherwise specified. Metrics are also shrunk based on certainty and stability, so it may take several games for a player to be appropriately ranked.

comparison.comparison_contract: Both legacy and new predictions are scored on the same target and the same rows. Legacy published errors against its former target are not treated as comparable.
comparison.pairing_policy: Every metric for both versions is computed on rows scoreable for both versions. Rows only one version can predict are excluded and counted in pairing_coverage rather than charged to the version that did predict them.
comparison.holdout_policy: The final two diagnosed seasons are reported as retired diagnostics and are never used to accept this enhancement.
comparison.justification: Acceptance is based only on pre-holdout rolling development: paired corrected-target RMSE, rank correlation, and a majority of development folds. The retired seasons remain visible even when they disagree.

scoring_anomalies.basis: Minimum 10 total points for point-profile tables and minimum 8 total goals for 5v5 goal-share. Points are derived from season goal events. 5v5 means exact 5 skaters vs 5 skaters with goalies on ice. Power-play points include all man-advantage goal points with a goalie in net. 5v5 + PP can be less than total because shorthanded, 4v4, 3v3, and extra-attacker situations are separate. 1-goal games use the final goal margin from season goal events.

recent_basis: Recent mover lists use custom rating changes versus the 2026-03-27 snapshot, which is the day before the weighted-median 10th most recent team game. Skater movers use overall talent score, team movers use total team score, goalie movers use goalie score, and usage lists compare the most recent 10 games to the previous 10.
